text:
You need someone who can run Facebook and TikTok campaigns for telecom clients, stay aligned with Israeli audiences, and use performance data to improve ROI.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, and reporting using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data visualization. While my background is analytics rather than media buying, I’ve supported marketing teams with clear performance insights that help guide budget and optimization decisions.  

In my Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of ad budget reallocated and helped reduce customer acquisition cost by 12% the next quarter.  

How are you currently measuring ROI across Facebook and TikTok for your telecom campaigns?
